standards_review.notes: all 14 commit subjects in the review range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format

guide prefers parameterized generics over bare dict; bare dict at hook.py:161, compressor.py:27 and :39, sdk_compressor.py:109, sidecar_compressor.py:37. Headers, __future__ annotations, cohesion conform.
no credential logging; strict JSON parsing. docker-compose headroom service defaults HEADROOM_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_BIND to 1 and empty HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN on 0.0.0.0; sidecar traffic is plain http.

findings.title: Sidecar defaults to unauthenticated bind
findings.problem: The headroom service sets HEADROOM_HOST=0.0.0.0, HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN defaults to empty and HEADROOM_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_BIND defaults to 1, so the default stack accepts unauthenticated /v1/compress calls from any container on the compose network. The backend sends no Authorization header unless a token is configured. The spec (section 4) requires internal-network-only with Bearer auth.
findings.impact: Full prompt and tool-output content is handled by an unauthenticated service by default; spec security requirement only partially met. No published port limits exposure to the compose network, and the default is commented as dev-only.
findings.recommendation: Default HEADROOM_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_BIND to 0 and require HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN, or confine the open default to an explicit dev-only override; wire the same HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN into the backend service env.

findings.title: Span mode attribute outside spec values
findings.problem: codemie.headroom.mode defaults to 'unknown' and is set to 'none' on the skipped_small path, but spec AC8 defines it as sidecar|sdk. Tests assert the out-of-spec values.
findings.impact: Dashboards filtering on sidecar|sdk see unexpected values; AC8 is only partially met.
findings.recommendation: Emit only sidecar|sdk (resolve the configured mode without calling the compressor), or amend spec.md AC8 and the span tests to document 'none' and 'unknown'.

findings.title: Bare dict annotations violate code-quality guide
findings.problem: _merge takes `compressed: dict`; list[dict] / bare dict is also used in compressor.py:27 and :39, sdk_compressor.py:109 and sidecar_compressor.py:37, contrary to code-quality.md which prefers parameterized generics.
findings.impact: Documented typing standard is unmet in new code and blocks the workflow per the standards review.
findings.recommendation: Annotate as dict[str, Any] and list[dict[str, Any]] in the listed signatures and CompressOutcome.messages.

findings.title: Non-ImportError SDK import failure retried per call
findings.problem: _load_sdk only catches ImportError. Any other import-time exception (e.g. OSError loading a native extension) propagates without setting _unavailable, so the process-wide os.environ writes and the heavy import are repeated under the lock on every model call.
findings.impact: In SDK mode a broken install degrades every agent step with repeated import attempts and repeated warnings, instead of disabling once like the ImportError path. Fail-open limits the failure to latency and log noise.
findings.recommendation: Catch Exception around the import, set _unavailable, log once and raise HeadroomCompressionError; add a test with an import raising OSError asserting a single attempt.

findings.title: Private _pipeline override untested against real SDK
findings.problem: All SDK-mode tests use hand-built fake headroom modules. _apply_marker_free_pipeline assigns sys.modules['headroom.compress']._pipeline, which never raises even if a future Headroom stops reading it, so its warning fallback cannot fire. research-findings.md section 7 item 3 states the override needs a test that fails when Headroom changes it; CompressConfig kwargs are likewise only checked against a fake accepting any kwargs. The real package is not installed in this environment, so reachability of the failure is unconfirmed.
findings.impact: After a Headroom upgrade, SDK mode could send the model unresolvable 'Retrieve more: hash=' markers or silently never compress while every test stays green.
findings.recommendation: Add a pytest.importorskip('headroom') test against the pinned 0.40.0 asserting a read _pipeline attribute, CompressConfig(**sdk_compress_kwargs(...)) construction for all strategies, and no 'Retrieve more: hash=' marker in balanced mode.
